hook.name: Politiswap
hook.description: A hook that manages Uniswap v4 ETH/political-token pools, collecting a 2% fee on each swap and tracking daily net ETH inflows per pool. Holders of the highest-inflow pool's token each day earn POLITISWAP token rewards distributed via quadratic decay over 365 days. Accumulated ETH fees trigger a buy-and-burn mechanism for POLITISWAP tokens.
